g.text: Sonar: how a Player's guesses become a coach's advice
the learner model, never the LLM
AI never runs during a Run:
tagged once, offline, by Gemini (sidecar JSON)
a miss blames the weaker of the Prompt's Concepts
a weak prerequisite holding ≥ 40% of recent blame
top 3 next actions, never a locked Topic
on every page except a Run
on Reveal, Topic and Module pages
the loop: Start → a new Run → new guesses → the model updates → better advice
